devdoc.details: Stores the canonical chain of validated D-PoDL models (blocks).      Enforces consensus rules (T1 hash threshold, T_acc accuracy threshold).      Manages D-PoDL parameters and rewards proposers.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

ModelAccepted(uint256,string,uint256,uin.details: Emitted when a new model block is successfully validated and added to the registry.

ParameterUpdated(string,uint256).details: Emitted when a D-PoDL parameter is updated by the owner.

RewardMintFailed(address,uint256).details: Emitted when a reward minting operation fails.

constructor.details: Initializes the contract, setting D-PoDL parameters and the token address.

params._initialBlockRewardAmount: The initial DPDL token reward per accepted block.
params._initialMaxTrainingSteps: The maximum number of training steps allowed (to prevent overtraining).
params._initialMinAccuracyImprovementBPS: The minimum accuracy improvement required over reference model.
params._initialMinStepImprovement: The minimum additional training steps required over reference model.
params._initialMinTrainingSteps: The minimum number of training steps required for model submission.
params._initialOwner: The address designated as the contract owner.
params._initialReferenceRewardShareBPS: The initial reference reward share in Basis Points (0-10000).
params._initialT1Threshold: The initial T1 hash difficulty threshold.
params._initialTAccuracyThresholdBPS: The initial accuracy threshold in Basis Points (1-10000).
params._tokenAddress: The address of the deployed DPoDLToken contract.

getBlockDetails(uint256).details: Returns the details of a specific model block by its height.

getBlockHeightForCID(string).details: Returns the block height for a given IPFS CID, or 0 if not found.

getCurrentReferenceModel().details: Returns the IPFS CID of the latest accepted model block.      Returns the genesisCID if no blocks have been added yet.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setBlockRewardAmount(uint256).details: Updates the block reward amount. Only callable by the owner.

params._newRewardAmount: The new reward amount per block.

setDpdlToken(address).details: Sets the DPDL token contract address. Only callable by the owner.

params._newTokenAddress: The address of the token contract.

setGenesisCID(string).details: Sets the genesis model CID, which can only be set once when empty.

params._genesisCID: The IPFS CID of the genesis model.

setMaxTrainingSteps(uint256).details: Updates the maximum training steps allowed. Only callable by the owner.

params._newMaxSteps: The new maximum training steps allowed.

setMinAccuracyImprovementBPS(uint256).details: Updates the minimum required accuracy improvement over reference model.

params._newMinImprovement: The new minimum improvement in basis points.

setMinStepImprovement(uint256).details: Updates the minimum required step increase over reference model.

params._newMinStepImprovement: The new minimum step improvement required.

setMinTrainingSteps(uint256).details: Updates the minimum training steps required. Only callable by the owner.

params._newMinSteps: The new minimum training steps required.

setReferenceRewardShareBPS(uint256).details: Updates the reference reward share (in BPS). Only callable by the owner.

params._newShareBPS: The new reference reward share in Basis Points (0-10000).

setT1Threshold(uint256).details: Updates the T1 hash threshold. Only callable by the owner.

setTAccuracyThresholdBPS(uint256).details: Updates the accuracy threshold (in BPS). Only callable by the owner.

params._newThresholdBPS: The new accuracy threshold in Basis Points (1-10000).

submitBlock(string,uint256,uint256,uint2.details: Allows a proposer to submit a potential new model block.      Validates the submission against D-PoDL consensus rules.      If valid, adds the block to the registry and rewards the proposer.

params._accuracyBPS: The accuracy achieved by the model (in Basis Points, 1-10000).
params._ipfsCID: The IPFS CID of the proposed model checkpoint.
params._postHash: The Post-Hash value calculated by the worker.
params._referenceModelCID: The CID of the model this submission was based on.
params._steps: The number of training steps performed.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

verifyModelImprovement(uint256,uint256,s.details: Verifies that a model has made sufficient improvement over its reference model.

params._accuracyBPS: The accuracy of the submitted model.
params._referenceModelCID: The CID of the reference model.
params._steps: The training steps of the submitted model.

returns._0: A boolean indicating if the improvement is sufficient.
